EN: Help 'Ol One-Eye shuffle off this mortal coil and collect your bounty!
ZH: 终结“独眼龙”的生命，领取赏金！

EN: Oh good. You must be the one who's going to take down Shiner.
ZH: 哦太好了。你应该就是那个能拿下“闪闪”的人。

EN: You ought to know, that Ghoul's got seriously thick skin.
ZH: 你要知道，那个尸鬼有着很厚很厚的皮肤。

EN: Energy weapons are about the only thing that'll pierce his scabby hide.
ZH: 能量武器是唯一能够穿透它粗糙外皮的东西。

EN: Good luck.
ZH: 祝你好运。

EN: The Glowing One known as “Shiner” has made trouble for the last time. Put him on ice to claim your reward.
ZH: 不能再让发光种“闪闪”惹麻烦了。干掉它，然后领取奖励。

EN: Bounty: Shiner
ZH: 悬赏：“闪闪”

EN: Kill Shiner.
ZH: 消灭尸鬼“闪闪”。

EN: Take down the Glowing One known as Shiner and claim your reward!
ZH: 拿下那个叫“闪闪”的发光种，领取赏金！

EN: Here to collect on “Snips?”
ZH: 是来领取“剪刀手”的赏金的吗？

EN: Well, you ought to know, that Radscorpion's got a hide like a vault door.
ZH: 不过，你要知道，那只辐射蝎的壳和避难所的门一样厚。

EN: Sure hope you brought in the big guns for this one.
ZH: 希望你们这次来带的都是大枪。

EN: But you take him down, I'll make it worth your while.
ZH: 只要你能拿下它，我的奖赏绝不会让你们失望。

EN: There's a bounty out on “Snips,” a Glowing Radscorpion. Put down that pest and the reward's as good as yours.
ZH: 外界正悬赏一只叫做“剪刀手”的发光辐射蝎。拿下那只害虫，大把的奖赏就是你的了！

EN: Bounty: Snips
ZH: 悬赏：“剪刀手”

EN: Exterminate “Snips.”
ZH: 消灭“剪刀手”

EN: Exterminate the Glowing Radscorpion known as “Snips” and claim the bounty on its carapace!
ZH: 消灭发光辐射蝎“剪刀手”，然后拿着它的壳领取赏金吧！

EN: Thank goodness you're here!
ZH: 谢天谢地你来了！

EN: That Yak's been stealing our food and stinking the place to high heaven!
ZH: 那只叫“牦牛”的鼹鼠妈妈一直在偷我们的食物，并让整个地方都臭翻了天！

EN: You're not going to want to get close to her, though.
ZH: 但你绝对不会想要靠近它。

EN: Make sure you use some kinda rifle or you're apt to yak yourself!
ZH: 请确保你用的是步枪，不然倒霉的可是你自己！

EN: The Mole rat brood mother known as “Yak” has stolen her last snackcake! Whack Yak to claim your reward.
ZH: 一只叫做“牦牛”的鼹鼠妈妈偷走了最后一块“俏男孩”蛋糕！除掉它然后领取你的奖励。

EN: Bounty: Yak
ZH: 悬赏：“牦牛”

EN: Whack Yak.
ZH: 除掉鼹鼠“牦牛”。

EN: Take down the Mole rat brood mother known as Yak and claim your reward!
ZH: 拿下鼹鼠妈妈“牦牛”，领取奖励！

EN: I could have SWORN this was the one. Guess not.
ZH: 我本来发誓这次一定能找到，但好像并不能。

EN: There's an old Wilson Automatoys factory we never checked out. Maybe Coach, and Rackie Jobinson's Jersey, are there...
ZH: 那儿有一个旧的威尔逊原子玩具厂，我们没有查看过。教练和罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫说不定会在那儿。

EN: Breaking all the Records
ZH: 打破所有记录

EN: Search for Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Find Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: We got a back issue from Vault 819. Until then all we had to read was an old copy of “One Ghoul, Two Ghoul.”
ZH: 我们从819号避难所那里得到了一本过期报刊。在那之前我们只有一本旧的《一只尸鬼，两只尸鬼》影印本可以读。

EN: That's right! We're heading out to hunt some Raiders - I'm destined to be a front page star! Vault 819 look out!
ZH: 你说的对！我们这就出发去追捕那些掠夺者—我注定会成为封面明星！819号避难所可得小心啦！

EN: Thanks for helping us with our infestation problem!
ZH: 感谢你们帮我们解决了虫灾问题！

EN: Our people have been running off on quests of derring-do in hopes of capturing the Bugle's eye...
ZH: 我们的人都跑出去干那些冒险的差事，就为了能入号角报的眼……

EN: No one's left to keep the joint clean!
ZH: 居然没人留下来打理这个地方！

EN: How did you get ahold of a copy of the Bugle?
ZH: 你是怎么拿到一份号角报的？

EN: So you can get in the Bugle by kicking butt and taking names?
ZH: 所以靠打架揍人扬名就能上号角报？

EN: What's this about a New Boston Bugle? It's a chance to have our exploits published for all the world to see! Fame! Fortune! Caps!
ZH: 新波士顿号角报到底意味着什么？是一次让我们的伟大功绩举世皆知的机会！代表着名气！钱财！瓶盖！

EN: Broadsides
ZH: 舷侧

EN: Learn about the New Boston Bugle.
ZH: 认识新波士顿号角报。

EN: Find out about the New Boston Bugle.
ZH: 找到关于新波士顿号角报的信息。

EN: Travellers have told us of a small squad of ex-Brotherhood of Steel types setting up some kind of commune in the area. Apparently they've got survivors, Ghouls, and raiders all living in supposed harmony together. Go investigate this community and see if the rumors are true. These people could make good allies and trade partners.
ZH: 旅行者告诉我们，有一小队前钢铁兄弟会成员在该地区建立了一个某种类型的公社。显然，他们成功地让幸存者、尸鬼和掠夺者和谐地生活在一起。去调查这个社区，看看传言是否属实。这些人有可能成为很好的盟友和贸易伙伴。

EN: Brotherhood of Feels
ZH: 温馨兄弟会

EN: Contact the Soldiers
ZH: 联系士兵

EN: Make contact with the strange group of survivors.
ZH: 与奇怪的幸存者群体联系。

EN: Hunter Big Wes has put out a series of challenges for anyone brave enough. The first is to bag a Glowing Radroach. Time to lock and load!
ZH: 猎人大维斯为勇者们准备了一系列挑战。第一件事就是抓住一只发光辐射蟑螂。给枪上好膛，准备出发吧！

EN: Bug Hunt
ZH: 抓虫达人

EN: Kill the Glowing Radroach.
ZH: 消灭发光辐射蟑螂。

EN: Kill the Glowing Radroach in the factory.
ZH: 消灭工厂里发光辐射蟑螂。

EN: Mole rats! Is there any creature more sneaky or disgusting? Grab a flamer and clear out a nest of those tunnelling terrors.
ZH: 鼹鼠！还有什么生物比它更卑鄙更恶心吗？拿起火焰喷射器来消灭这一窝“隧道恐怖分子”吧。

EN: Burnout
ZH: 烧光

EN: Clear out the Mole rat nest.
ZH: 捣毁鼹鼠巢穴。

EN: Put a nest of pesky Mole rats to the torch.
ZH: 一把火烧了这一窝讨厌的鼹鼠。

EN: That's still indicative of a quality establishment!
ZH: 这仍然是好企业的象征！

EN: That was boeuf bourguignon, and it was spectacular!
ZH: 那是勃垦地牛肉，真是太不可思议了！

EN: You try making marzipan without any almonds!
ZH: 你试着做不加杏仁的杏仁软糖！

EN: Egads! The Dwellers found us!
ZH: 天哪！那些居民发现了我们！

EN: Well, you may have survived my cooking...
ZH: 好吧，你可能承受住了我的烹饪……

EN: But you won't survive my shooting!
ZH: 但是你将无法从我的枪口下逃脱！

EN: Bad food, bad service... I give this place one star.
ZH: 烂食物，烂服务……这地方我给一星评价。

EN: You cooked your last meal, chef.
ZH: 你做了你这辈子的最后一顿烹饪，厨师。

EN: You'll pay for using rolled fondant on all your cakes!
ZH: 你会为在所有的蛋糕上使用软糖而付出代价的！

EN: As it turns out, the chef *really* was trying to kill us all. Seems he's with a band of Raiders who've been eyeing our Vault. He fled as soon as he was exposed, but we know he's set to meet other Raiders at an abandoned Red Rocket.
ZH: 事实证明，厨师之前是真的想害死我们所有人。看来他是一伙觊觎我们避难所的掠夺者的同伙，他一露馅便逃走了，但我们知道他打算在一个废弃的红火箭加油站与其他掠夺者会合。

EN: By Hook or by Cook
ZH: 用钩或用煮

EN: Kill the Chef.
ZH: 消灭厨师。

EN: Kill the renegade chef.
ZH: 消灭叛变的厨师。

EN: Engage! Engage!
ZH: 开火！开火！

EN: Uh-oh.
ZH: 哦。

EN: The cloaking fields are working!
ZH: 隐形场有用！

EN: Oh look, a surface Dweller...
ZH: 哦看，一个地表居民……

EN: Good thing our experimental cloaking fields are up.
ZH: 好事情，我们实验隐形场起作用了。

EN: This way we can study it in its natural habitat without being seen.
ZH: 这样我们就可以在它的自然栖息地研究它而不被看见。

EN: Shh, it's coming our way...
ZH: 嘘，它正朝我们这边过来……

EN: You guys know I can see you, right?
ZH: 嘿兄弟们，你们知道我能看见你们，对吧？

EN: I feel a sudden urge to shoot that area of empty space, right there.
ZH: 我突然有一种冲动想去朝那个空地开枪，就在那里。

EN: I'm going to pretend I didn't see and hear that.
ZH: 我要假装我没有看到和听到。

EN: One of your dwellers has heard cries coming from an abandoned cabin. They should investigate to see if anyone needs help!
ZH: 你的一个居民听到一个废弃的小屋里发出叫声。他们应该调查看看是否有人需要帮助！

EN: Cabin Fever
ZH: 幽居病

EN: Investigate the noises coming from the cabin.
ZH: 调查来自小屋里的噪音。

EN: Investigate strange sounds coming from a derelict cabin.
ZH: 调查一个废弃小屋发出的奇怪声音。

EN: While exploring the Wasteland, one of your Dwellers discovered a spooky cabin in the middle of nowhere. It's not haunted... probably.
ZH: 正在探索废土的居民在某个荒郊野岭发现了一处阴森的小屋。大概没有……闹鬼吧。

EN: Cabin Without The Woods
ZH: 神秘小屋

EN: Eliminate the Ghouls.
ZH: 除掉尸鬼。

EN: Eliminate the Ghouls in the Abandoned Cabin.
ZH: 除掉废弃小屋里的尸鬼。

EN: That flea bag ran off with the others. Probably to Vault 199. It'll be the first place we look once we're finished with you!
ZH: 那个家伙一定是和其他人一起逃走了。说不定是199号避难所。干掉你们之后我们就立刻去那里。

EN: Intruders! You must be the ones that freed our prisoners.
ZH: 入侵者！那个把我们的囚犯放走的人一定是你们。

EN: We didn't spend all that time tying them up and keeping them alive, just for them to run away! Talk about rude.
ZH: 我们没有将他们绑住，还保证他们活着，结果他们居然逃跑了！什么玩意！

EN: No one appreciates good captors these days!
ZH: 这年头可没有人会感激好心的牢头！

EN: So Bigsby isn't here anymore?
ZH: 所以比格斯比不在这里了吗？

EN: I need to search an old warehouse to try and find Bigsby. The Raiders are using it as a hideout, so I'll need to be careful.
ZH: 我得去搜搜那座旧仓库，看看能不能找到比格斯比。掠夺者把它当成了藏身处，所以我得小心点。

EN: Canine Recovery
ZH: 寻找狗狗

EN: Find Bigsby.
ZH: 找到比格斯比。

EN: Look for Bigsby in the old warehouse.
ZH: 在旧仓库里寻找比格斯比。

EN: Do you know how long it took me to set this up?
ZH: 你们知道我花了多长时间才把这个装好吗？

EN: I was going to have an army of Radroaches at my disposal.
ZH: 我本来会有一个军队的辐射蟑螂来供我支配。

EN: And now, you've ruined everything!
ZH: 而现在，一切都被你们给毁了！

EN: You're going to pay!
ZH: 你们会付出代价的！

EN: A strange, high-pitched sound is coming through over the radio. The signal seems to originate from an old, abandoned builidng.
ZH: 一个奇怪而刺耳的声音从广播里传来。信号好像是从一幢废弃的旧建筑里发出的。

EN: Can't Stop The Signal
ZH: 无法停止信号

EN: Find the signal's source.
ZH: 寻找信号源。

EN: Investigate a strange radio broadcast.
ZH: 侦查一个奇怪的无线电广播站。

EN: There's a large stash of Caps out there in the Wasteland with your name on it.
ZH: 废土上有一大笔瓶盖储备，上面写着你的名字。

EN: Caps Run
ZH: 瓶盖大作战

EN: Recover the main stash of Caps.
ZH: 追回主要的瓶盖储备。

EN: Find more stashes of Caps.
ZH: 发现更多的瓶盖储备。

EN: Find more stashes of Caps.
ZH: 发现更多的瓶盖储备。

EN: Find the hidden stash of Caps.
ZH: 发现隐藏的瓶盖储备。

EN: There's a lost and lonely animal who'd love to come home to your Vault. Too bad some hungry Ghouls found it first.
ZH: 有一只孤单的迷路小动物想和你一起回避难所的家。但令人讨厌的是一些饥饿的尸鬼先发现了它。

EN: Captured Critter
ZH: 拯救小动物

EN: Rescue the Pet from the hungry Ghouls.
ZH: 从饥饿的尸鬼手中拯救宠物。

EN: Save a lost Pet from some hungry Ghouls.
ZH: 从一些尸鬼手中拯救迷失的宠物。

EN: No Jersey in sight. Though I do see a nice polyester leisure suit.
ZH: 没有看见棒球衫。倒是发现了一套不错的休闲西装。

EN: If Coach was at Lakeville Library, he checked out of there a long time ago. Maybe he went to Fallon's Department Store for some slacks to match that Jersey...
ZH: 就算教练到过莱克维尔图书馆，他也很早就离开了。也许他去肥伦百货商店，想找条裤子配上那件棒球衫……

EN: Cheap Beer in the Bleacher Seats
ZH: 看台座椅上的廉价啤酒

EN: Search for Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Find Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Hurray! Here. We saved up and want you to have this present!
ZH: 噢耶！拿着吧，这是我们特意保存下来的，现在我们希望你能拥有它！

EN: We see how it is, smoothskins! Get out of here.
ZH: 我们算是看清你们了，“光滑皮肤”们！赶紧滚吧！

EN: You're here! Santa didn't forget about us.
ZH: 你来了！看来圣诞老人没有忘记我们。

EN: We've been very good Ghouls this year!
ZH: 今年我们尸鬼都很乖哦！

EN: You'll let him know that, won't you?
ZH: 你会告诉他的，对吧？

EN: Of course! He'll be here real soon with a “Ho ho ho!”
ZH: 当然！很快他就会带着他那招牌式的“嗬嗬嗬！”的笑声来这里了。

EN: Sorry, all Ghouls are on the naughty list this year. You get nothing.
ZH: 抱歉，所有的尸鬼今年都上了我的“坏孩子”名单。你们什么礼物都拿不到了。

EN: Hmph. Fine. But tell Santa we deserve more next year!
ZH: 呃，好吧。但是你告诉圣诞老人，明年可得给我们更好的东西！

EN: Die, smoothskins!
ZH: “光滑皮肤”们，去死吧！

EN: You're Santa's Helpers, huh?
ZH: 你是圣诞老人的助手，对吧？

EN: We think we deserve more than just “cheer” this year.
ZH: 我们觉得今年应该得到比“鼓励奖”更好的东西。

EN: And it'll be easier to just kill you and take your things!
ZH: 而且直接杀了你，然后拿走你的东西貌似更容易！

EN: You can't kill us! What would Santa think? That's permanent naughty list stuff.
ZH: 你不能杀了我们！而且你们觉得圣诞老人会怎么想？那会让你们永远留在“坏孩子”的黑名单上！

EN: No one's stealing Christmas this year! En garde!
ZH: 今年谁也别想偷走圣诞节！接招吧！

EN: Think we got something right up your alley.
ZH: 我觉得有样东西正合你们的心意。

EN: Here you are.
ZH: 给你。

EN: Heh. Right you are.
ZH: 嘿，你说得没错。

EN: Well, all right, maybe the holidays aren't dead after all!
ZH: 那么，好吧，也许节日什么的还没有完全消亡！

EN: Hey there, smoothskins. Name's Jim. I'm in charge around here.
ZH: “光滑皮肤”们，你们好啊。我叫吉姆，是这片的负责人。

EN: Thanks for bringing a little holiday cheer our way.
ZH: 谢谢你们给我们这里带来了一点节日的气息。

EN: In the spirit of things, I'd like to send you home with a gift.
ZH: 秉着节日的传统，我想送一个礼物给你们带回家。

EN: So, what do you want for Christmas, smoothskins?
ZH: 所以，“光滑皮肤”们，你们想要什么圣诞礼物呢？

EN: Guns. Lots of guns.
ZH: 枪。很多很多的枪。

EN: We're fashion nuts. Some new outfits, please!
ZH: 我们是时尚达人，所以想要新衣服，拜托了！

EN: Nothing wrong with bottlecaps.
ZH: 瓶盖永远不会嫌多。

EN: We don't need anything. We just enjoy helping out!
ZH: 我们什么都不需要。我们只是乐于助人！

EN: Everyone forgets those poor Ghouls need holiday cheer, too!
ZH: 每个人都忘了那些可怜的尸鬼们也想过节！

EN: Cheer for the Ghouls
ZH: 为尸鬼制造节日气氛

EN: Speak to the Ghoul Leader.
ZH: 和尸鬼首领聊聊。

EN: Talk to the Ghouls.
ZH: 和尸鬼交谈。

EN: Talk to the Ghouls.
ZH: 和尸鬼交谈。

EN: Spread Christmas cheer!
ZH: 传播圣诞的节日气氛！

EN: Really? Thanks! We were wondering how to get rid of it. We even tried this!
ZH: 真的吗？谢谢！我们想知道如何摆脱它。我们甚至试过这个！

EN: All right, have it your way!
ZH: 好吧，照你说的做！

EN: You guys actually eat that? We could kill you, but this actually sounds worse...
ZH: 你们真的吃了那个？我们可以杀了你，但吃那个听着更糟……

EN: What do you want, Dwellers?
ZH: 你们想要什么，居民们？

EN: There is nothing of value in this place, only junk.
ZH: 这个地方没有有价值的东西，只有垃圾。

EN: You should turn around and leave.
ZH: 你们应该掉头离开。

EN: We're just here to clean the gray goo off the machinery.
ZH: 我们只是来清理这些机器上的灰色粘液。

EN: Not before we get what we came for.
ZH: 除非我们得到我们想要的。

EN: Our chef wants us to bring back processed cheese, and we will.
ZH: 我们的厨师希望我们带回加工奶酪，我们会的。

EN: The chef is happy - and surprised - that you made it back in one piece! He now requires processed cheese, AKA gray gold, the miracle food that endures the passage of time and nuclear war. Some may be left in the old Cheese Factory.
ZH: 厨师很高兴——也很惊讶——你完好无损地把它带回来了！他现在需要加工过的奶酪，也就是灰金奶酪，这种神奇的食物能经受住时间和核战争的考验。有些可能留在老奶酪厂。

EN: Cheese, Please!
ZH: 请给我奶酪！

EN: Retrieve cheese paste from the factory.
ZH: 从工厂取回芝士酱。

EN: Kill the Glowing One.
ZH: 消灭发光种。

EN: Obtain processed cheese from the abandoned factory.
ZH: 从废弃的工厂取回加工过的奶酪。

EN: We came here with grate expectations.
ZH: 我们怀着极大的期望来到这里。

EN: This place seems uncontaminated by cheese...
ZH: 这个地方似乎没有奶酪……

EN: Do Ghouls like Gouda?
ZH: 尸鬼喜欢豪达奶酪吗？

EN: So you're the Pain Train? Don't make me laugh!
ZH: 所以你就是“会痛的火车”？别逗了！

EN: You ain't railroading us!
ZH: 可别想在我们身上铺铁轨！

EN: One of your Dwellers won't stop calling themselves “The Pain Train.” Let's make that nickname a reality...
ZH: 你的一位居民一直称自己是“会痛的火车”。我们来让他梦想成真……

EN: Choo-Choo!
Kill the Raider Boss.
ZH: 消灭掠夺者首领。

EN: Send a lone Vault Dweller with a Railway Rifle out to wreak havoc!
ZH: 派一位拿着射钉步枪的居民去搞一场大破坏吧！

EN: He'll give us free stuff? All right. You Dwellers can pass.
ZH: 他会免费给我们东西？好吧，你们这些居民可以走了。

EN: You're dead, and the North Pole is next!
ZH: 你死定了。北极是下一个目标！

EN: Well, well, it's Santa's little helpers!
ZH: 嗬嗬，原来是圣诞老人的小帮手来了！

EN: Make it quick. We got settlements to pillage!
ZH: 动作快点，我们还有定居点要去抢呢。

EN: Santa's watching you. Be nice or he won't give you presents!
ZH: 圣诞老人正在看着你。最好表现好点，不然什么礼物都得不到！

EN: Santa sends the gift... Of death! Eat lead!
ZH: 圣诞老人送来了……死亡之礼！尝尝我的子弹吧！

EN: You know what? Why not? “Twinkle twinkle little star...”
ZH: 你知道吗？为什么不呢？“一闪一闪亮晶晶……”

EN: Time to rumble!
ZH: 开打时间到！

EN: Santa's Helpers, huh?
ZH: 圣诞老人的小帮手，是吧？
